title: 第7章 军工利益复合体第8章 我与项目共成长
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
捉妖大会观礼台，祥云翻腾，仙光缭绕。
众仙家按品阶落座，低声交谈。
一道清瘦的身影低调入场。
正是太白金星。
老金星入场，在场众仙却无人起身相迎，更无老友上来寒暄。
众仙目光或直视前方，或与旁人谈笑，仿佛没看见他。
太白寻了个不起眼的位置坐下，双目低垂，默默不语。
苏元侍立在侧，将这一切看在眼里。
忽然，前方一阵骚动。
文曲星君身着华服，在一众仙官簇拥下昂然而入，
身旁跟着其弟武曲星君，甲胄鲜明，神采飞扬。
沿途仙家纷纷起身，热情招呼，更有甚者主动让出最前方视野绝佳的席位。
文曲星君含笑颔首，与武曲星君在前排落座，谈笑风生，风光无两。
苏元心中暗忖：
“怪不得文曲星君在主战一事上如此积极，原是为其弟武曲铺路。”
倏忽间，一道金光洒落，天花乱坠，地涌金莲，异象纷呈。
玉帝分身高悬于观礼台正上方，紫气氤氲。
众仙齐齐躬身：“见过陛下。”
捉妖正式开始。
十万天兵天将驾临花果山上空，旌旗蔽日，气势雄浑。

众人感应到气机，纷纷望下去。
只见一片翻滚涌动的金色云海渐渐生成。
天兵天将、花果山众妖全部被遮在云海之下。
“搞什么？怎么全遮住了？”
有仙人不满地嘟囔。
武曲星君立刻朗声解说，语气颇为自豪：
“诸位仙友莫急！
此乃我天庭兵部最新研制、耗费巨资打造的天罗地网！”
“不仅威力绝伦，更能隔绝内外窥探，保证不会走脱一只妖物！
此战，定叫那妖猴插翅难飞！”
苏元冷眼看着，心中了然。
影响中枢决策，挑起地缘冲突，巨资研发产品，主导中层将领，牺牲基层士兵。
这主战派盘根错节，俨然成了一个庞大的利益复合体，只是这套路，似乎格外眼熟。
果然太阳底下没有新鲜事。
content_en:
At the viewing platform of the Monster Catching Conference, auspicious clouds were billowing and fairy lights were lingering.
All the immortals sat down according to their rank and chatted in low voices.
A thin figure entered the room in a low-key manner.
It is Taibai Venus.
Old Jinxing entered the scene, but no one among the immortals stood up to greet him, and no old friends came up to greet him.
The immortals either stared straight ahead or chatted and laughed with others, as if they had not seen him.
Taibai found an inconspicuous place and sat down, his eyes lowered and silent.
Su Yuanshi stood by and saw all this.
Suddenly, there was a commotion ahead.
Wenquxingjun, dressed in gorgeous clothes, walked in proudly surrounded by a group of immortal officials.
Next to him is his younger brother Wuqu Xingjun, with bright armor and high spirits.
Along the way, the immortals stood up one after another and greeted them warmly, and some even took the initiative to give up their seats at the front with excellent views.
Wenqu Xingjun nodded with a smile, and he and Wuqu Xingjun sat in the front row, chatting and laughing happily, and the scenery was indistinguishable.
Su Yuan thought to himself:
"No wonder Wenqu Xingjun is so active in the main battle. It is to pave the way for his younger brother Wuqu."
Suddenly, a golden light fell, flowers fell from the sky, golden lotuses sprouted from the ground, and various visions appeared.
The Jade Emperor's avatar is suspended directly above the viewing platform, filled with purple air.
All the immortals bowed together: "I have met Your Majesty."
The monster hunting officially begins.
Hundreds of thousands of heavenly soldiers and generals descended over the Huaguo Mountain, their banners covering the sun, and their momentum was majestic.
Everyone sensed the energy and looked down one after another.
I saw a rolling sea of ​​golden clouds gradually forming.
The heavenly soldiers, heavenly generals, and all the monsters in Huaguo Mountain were all covered by the sea of ​​clouds.
"What are you doing? Why is it all covered?"
Some immortals muttered dissatisfiedly.
Wu Quxingjun immediately explained loudly, his tone was quite proud:
“Fellow immortals, don’t be impatient!
This is the latest dragnet developed by our Heavenly Military Department and cost a huge amount of money to build! "
“Not only is it extremely powerful, it can also isolate itself from prying eyes from inside and outside, ensuring that no monster will escape!
This battle will definitely make it difficult for the demon monkey to fly! "
Su Yuan looked at it coldly, understanding in his heart.
Influencing central decision-making, provoking geopolitical conflicts, investing heavily in product research and development, dominating middle-level generals, and sacrificing lower-level soldiers.
This main war faction is intricately connected and has become a huge complex of interests, but this routine seems particularly familiar.
Sure enough, there is nothing new under the sun.
